prompt: A pill exists that makes you 10% better at everything you practice, but erases one memory of your choosing. Would you take it? Take a clear position and defend it.
criteria: Must take an explicit yes/no position, name a concrete tradeoff (what a memory is worth vs. a flat skill gain), and engage with at least one consequence of the choice — either what kind of memory loss does to identity or what universal uptake would do to society. Restating the prompt without a position fails.
